topic: Fixing impression calculation for virtual sensors
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on correcting the calculation of impressions, particularly when dealing with virtual sensors. Previously, the `impression_model()` function could return a single row or multiple rows for a given facility/category pair. The core issue was that the main data frame (`df`) contained records for both real and virtual sensors, while the impression model output did not account for virtual sensors lacking necessary calculation parameters.

The previous merging method relied on implicit data alignment (concatenating results based on row order), which failed when the number of rows returned by `impression_model()` did not match the size of the main data frame. This led to incorrect data association, especially between real and virtual sensor records.

The proposed fix involves explicitly joining/merging the impression data using keys (facility ID) to ensure accurate assignment of impressions only for real sensors, aligning with current best practices.
decisions: The calculation logic has been updated to correctly handle impressions by merging on facility keys.
Impressions will now be calculated and reported only for physical/real sensors.
action_items: Reviewer needs to review the submitted GitHub changes (diff) and approve/merge them.
